files.alt: Cover card: your habit app is lying to you about Tuesday.
files.text: Your habit app is lying to you about Tuesday.

files.alt: Card 1: one missed day didn't erase your progress; the counter reset, not you.
files.text: Lie 1: one missed day erased your progress. A streak at zero says a month of work is gone. It isn't. The counter reset, not you.

files.alt: Card 2: a red X doesn't mean failure; look at the week, not the gap.
files.text: Lie 2: a red X means you failed. A missed day is information, not an error. Look at the week, not the gap.

files.alt: Card 3: twelve habits on day one is a plan to quit; start with one.
files.text: Lie 3: more habits means more progress. Twelve habits on day one is a plan to quit by Friday. Start with one.

files.alt: Card 4: a daily view hides the trend; five out of seven is a good week.
files.text: Lie 4: today is the only day that counts. A daily view hides the trend. Five good days out of seven is a good week.

files.alt: Card 5: guilt notifications work until you mute them.
files.text: Lie 5: guilt is good motivation. "Don't break your streak!" at 11pm works right up until you mute it.

files.alt: Card 6: the goal is still doing it in March; consistent beats perfect.
files.text: Lie 6: a perfect week is the goal. The goal is still doing it in March. Consistent beats perfect.

files.alt: Closing card: send this to someone who deleted a habit app out of guilt.
files.text: Send this to someone who deleted a habit app out of guilt.
